name: Brushless motors
summary: Brushless DC motors: efficient, long-lived motors in e-bikes, drones, fans, washers and hard drives.
uses: Efficient wind and water generators (hub motors work well)
E-bike and cart drives, with their controller
identify: Usually three thick phase wires plus a bundle of thin Hall sensor wires. Hub motors in e-bikes, scooters and hoverboards; outrunners in drones and RC models; flat direct-drive motors in front-loading washers; small ones in PC fans and hard drives.
test: Spin the shaft with two phase wires shorted: it should feel notchy and stiff. Spun open, any two phases give AC volts. Opening one is risky: the magnets slam the rotor back in and pinch fingers.
